test_overview: Evaluated 6 test steps against the family-venue finder app at localhost:8000 using two browser contexts (Context A = admin, Context B = visitor). All steps passed: admin logged in with admin/admin123, created establishment 'Gallery Keyword Test' (id=23) with specified attributes, which navigated to /admin/establishments/23/edit showing the saved name (no 'Possible Duplicate' name modification). Three photos were uploaded: photo1 (test_photo_1.jpg) auto-became Primary with default 'Food & Drinks' category (non-fatal check), was changed to Menu; photo2 (test_photo_2.png) was Food & Drinks; photo3 (test_photo_3.jpg) was set to Interior; Photos header showed (3/20) with all categories clearly indicated. In visitor Context B, the venue detail gallery showed tabs All/Menu/Food & Drinks/Interior with 3/1/1/1 photos respectively. Two hashtag reviews were added, and after reload the 'What people say' keywords appeared exactly as #coffee, #cozy, #clean, #friendly. Finally, the establishment was deleted from the admin dashboard with a confirmation modal mentioning the name, and it no longer appears in the list. Total: 38/38 points.
